name: Table
summary: Data in rows and columns with header cells.

anatomy.description: Lines between rows; a hover tint.
A row spanning every column for loading, empty or error: a .nd-state with a sentence, a hint and, for an error, a way to try again.

variants.description: Scrolls horizontally inside its own region on narrow screens.

cues.loading: Placeholder rows (skeleton, aria-hidden) keep the layout; the region is aria-busy and a status message says what is loading.
cues.empty: A sentence that says nothing matches or nothing exists yet, and what to do next; not an empty frame.
cues.error: The error glyph and a sentence that says what failed, with a way to try again; data already shown stays.

keyboard.action: To the scroll region when it overflows.

a11y.name: Its caption.
notes: An overflowing table sits in a focusable region with a label (1.4.10).
Loading, empty and error are announced through a status region (role=status); the placeholder rows are hidden from assistive technology.

platforms.ios: Table (macOS, iPad) or a List of rows
